plain_english_policy: Support the lower 0.08 blood-alcohol-content limit defining drunk driving.

effects.rationale: Setting a legal blood-alcohol limit is an intervention in the market of driving behavior.
Restricting drunk driving through lower BAC limits aims to reduce harm and promote public safety, which can be seen as a restriction on individual freedom in the context of welfare policy.
